capabilities: Chat with an AI model in a sidebar panel with streaming replies
Read, create, patch, and overwrite notes through agent tools
Search the vault full-text and list files and folders on request
Switch model and reasoning effort from the composer
Point requests at any endpoint implementing the Anthropic /v1/messages streaming API
extras: Pending review and not yet in the community plugin list; manual or BRAT installation only. The API key is stored in plaintext in the vault's plugin data file and travels with synced vaults. Prompts and the content of read or edited notes are sent to Anthropic, or to whatever Base URL is configured; there is no other telemetry.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in AI assistant, and AI plugins that rely on Node.js, a local CLI, or a companion server do not run on Obsidian mobile.

relations.evidence: It calls the Anthropic Messages API directly from the client
Install BRAT and add the beta plugin Charlesxiaomi/claudian-mobile.

summary: Minimal AI chat agent that calls the Anthropic Messages API directly and can read, write, edit, and search vault notes on mobile and desktop.
